title: Correct μ₁ value
description: Essential: Student must state μ₁ = 0.4 (or equivalent fraction) as the coefficient between block and plate.

title: Correct μ₂ value
description: Essential: Student must state μ₂ = 0.2 (or equivalent fraction) as the coefficient between plate and surface.

title: Correct total displacement
description: Essential: Student must state the plate's total displacement as 2.625 m (or equivalent).

title: Uses graph for accelerations
description: Important: Student correctly extracts block accelerations from the given v-t graph slopes for both time intervals.

title: Applies Newton's second law
description: Important: Student sets up force equations for the block and plate separately, especially for the first interval where they move relative to each other.

title: Identifies relative motion phase
description: Important: Student recognizes that from t=0 to t1, the block slips on the plate, so friction is kinetic.

title: Calculates plate's initial velocity
description: Optional: Student calculates the plate's initial velocity (v0 = 4.5 m/s) using kinematic relations from the graph.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Student makes a sign error in acceleration directions or friction force directions in equations of motion.

title: Mass confusion
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses masses (M, m, M+m) in normal force calculations for friction.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Final answers lack proper units or have inconsistent units (e.g., missing 'm' for displacement).
